metadata.name: MovePlanBalance
metadata.description: This API is used to submit the Transactions for loan conversion.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: UserID
request_fields.description: UserID for user being updated Valid Values: 0-9 A-Z Format:XXXXXX Example: DemoAdmin

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtain by card number. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 1236547896325874 Condition: At least one of Card Number\Admin Number\Account Number is required Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Card Holders Account number. Valid Values:0-9 Example:7314145404845678 Condition: At least one of Card Number\Admin Number\Account Number is required Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 12345 Condition: At least one of Card Number\Admin Number\Account Number is required

request_fields.name: TransactionAmount
request_fields.description: Total amount which should be moved to different plan. Valid Values: 0-9 Example:500.00 Condition: Optional only when BNPL Conversion is at Transaction level.

request_fields.name: InvoiceNumber
request_fields.description: Invoice Number of the Transaction Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:987567757

request_fields.name: FromCPSID
request_fields.description: CPS ID of the plan which need to be moved to other plan. Valid Values: 0 - 9 Example: 72453

request_fields.name: FromPlanID
request_fields.description: ID of the plan which need to be moved to other plan. Valid Values: 0 - 9 Example: 72455

request_fields.name: ToPlanID
request_fields.description: ID of the plan to which we are moving. Valid Values: 0 - 9 Example: 72456

request_fields.name: TransactionID
request_fields.description: Unique ID of transaction, multiple values can be provided comma separated. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 185455555 Condition: Transaction ID will only Require for Transaction BNPL Conversion.

request_fields.name: InterestPlanID
request_fields.description: Interest Plan Id which needs to be updated on Plan to be moved. Valid Values:0-9, A-Z Format: XX Example: 1233 Condition: Interest Plan Override setup should be enabled at Plan Master.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: PlanSegmentID
children.description: Indicates the unique ID generated for each plan segment added to an account. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:98756775 Allowable Values: 10

children.name: ResponseID
children.description: This number indicates that API responded. Response ID is unique. This value will be null if no authentication information was passed. Response ID can be used for tracking Valid Values:0-9 Example:478585 Allowable Values: 15
